name: vam-vault-template
description: Vault connector: mounts an Obsidian vault as an obsidian-<slug> MCP server, reading the path from ${VAM_VAULT_<SLUG>}. Installed as-is it serves one vault as obsidian-example from ${VAM_VAULT_EXAMPLE} — enough for a single-vault machine. Copy it to vam-vault-<slug>/ for a second vault, or to name a vault something meaningful. See references/vaults.md in vam-knowledge.
